To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) annotation-based extraction is more accurate than distantly supervised extraction, but distantly supervised extraction can handle more websites and more attributes; (b) OpenTag is more accurate than RNN and CRF, and can handle more attributes and more product titles; (c) our techniques can be applied to extract knowledge from product titles, bullet points and long descriptions, and can be extended to other types of text such as customer reviews, product specifications, and product images.

(1) annotation-based extraction is more effective than distantly supervised extraction, (2) active learning is more effective than random sampling for distantly supervised extraction and (3) attention mechanism is more effective for attribute value extraction.

(i) we can achieve high precision and recall in attribute extraction from product text profiles, and (ii) we can achieve over 90 precision and recall in extraction of attribute values from product text profiles.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the extraction of structured data from text.

the development of scalable and effective techniques for extracting product attributes and their values from text and semi-structured sources, and we are currently working on improving these techniques in the context of a real production system.
developing techniques for extracting product knowledge from a variety of data sources with different levels of structure and quality.

we have developed advanced extraction techniques that can achieve over 90-95% precision and recall on a wide range of product websites, including long-tail and multi-lingual websites.

our annotation-based extraction tool can achieve high precision and recall in most cases, our distantly supervised extraction can work well in long-tail websites, and our OpenTag technique can extract values with high accuracy even for unseen attribute values.

the extraction tools we are using have been able to achieve high precision and recall, while handling long-tail and noisy websites in different languages, which are the key requirements to extract product knowledge from the web.

we can extract product attributes and attribute values with high precision and recall, even when training data is scarce.
we are able to extract product knowledge from various sources with high precision and recall.
